question: Totaram Sharma is a famous _________ player.
solution:
The correct answer is __**pakhawaj**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The pakhavaj **is a **barrel-shaped**, **two-headed drum**, originating from the **Indian subcontinent**, the **oldest version **of the **double-sided drum **and its descendants are the **mridangam **of **Southern India **and the **kendang **of Maritime **Southeast Asia **and **other South Asian double-headed drums**.
 
• It is the **percussion instrument **most **commonly **used in the **dhrupad **style of **Indian classical music **and less **often **used as a **rhythm accompaniment **for various other sub-forms of music and dance performances (e.g. kathak, Odissi, Marathi).
 
• It was **originally made **from **clay **and you still can find **clay versions**, but **very rarely**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
